sql.lockOwner: SELECT user_id,password_hash FROM n_users WHERE user_id=:user_id AND is_active=1 AND status='active' FOR UPDATE
sql.credentialList: SELECT credential_id,label,created_at,last_used_at FROM n_webauthn_credentials WHERE user_id=:user_id ORDER BY created_at DESC,credential_id
sql.credentialRead: SELECT credential_id,user_id,public_x,public_y,sign_count,backup_eligible,backed_up,label,created_at,last_used_at FROM n_webauthn_credentials WHERE credential_id=:credential_id FOR UPDATE
sql.credentialUse: UPDATE n_webauthn_credentials SET sign_count=:sign_count,backed_up=:backed_up,last_used_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE credential_id=:credential_id AND user_id=:user_id
sql.credentialDelete: DELETE FROM n_webauthn_credentials WHERE credential_id=:credential_id AND user_id=:user_id
sql.challengePrune: DELETE FROM n_webauthn_challenges WHERE expires_at <= LOCALTIMESTAMP
sql.challengeLock: SELECT challenge,engine_state FROM n_webauthn_challenges WHERE challenge_id=:challenge_id AND issuer=:issuer AND purpose=:purpose AND expires_at>LOCALTIMESTAMP AND (purpose='login' OR (owner_user_id=:owner_user_id AND owner_session_id=:owner_session_id)) FOR UPDATE
